definitions.explanation: An established rule or code of conduct within a group, organization, or community. Unlike formal laws, 掟 typically refers to unwritten rules, traditional codes, or the internal rules of a specific group. Often carries connotations of strictness and the consequences of violation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暗黙|あんもく}→暗黙：12876_anmoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掟|おきて}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are unspoken rules in this world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掟|おきて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{背|そむ}いた→背く：19577_somuku⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Those who defy the organization's code face severe punishment.

notes:
USAGE:
{掟|おきて} refers to rules that are often unwritten, traditional, or enforced within a specific community rather than by formal legal systems. It appears frequently in historical or dramatic contexts — samurai codes, village laws, underworld rules. In modern usage, it can refer metaphorically to any strict unwritten norm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {掟|おきて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break a rule/code
- {掟|おきて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{背|そむ}く→背く：19577_somuku⟧: to defy the rules
- {掟|おきて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to observe the rules
- ⟦{暗黙|あんもく}→暗黙：12876_anmoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掟|おきて}: unspoken rule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧: rule, regulation (formal, institutional)
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧: law (legal system)
- ⟦しきたり→しきたり：14951_shikitari⟧: custom, tradition (emphasis on established practice)
